items.quote: Wenn Sie verhindert sind, sagen Sie bitte mindestens zwei Werktage vorher ab, damit wir den Termin anderweitig vergeben können.
items.computation: Appointment is Monday 14.12.2026. 'Werktage' = Monday–Saturday excluding public holidays. Counting backwards from the appointment: Sunday 13.12.2026 is not a Werktag (not counted). Saturday 12.12.2026 is a Werktag = 1st working day before. Friday 11.12.2026 is a Werktag = 2nd working day before. So cancellation must reach the practice by Friday 11.12.2026 to satisfy 'at least two Werktage vorher'. This is a private, practice-set notice period and does not shift for weekends/holidays per the letter's own wording (it is itself defined in working days).

warnings: This is a routine private dental-practice reminder with no payment demand, authority action, or suspicious elements; nothing to flag as a scam risk.
